thread:
tess: CI alert: docs/runtime/quickstart.md curl sample failing with 403 in curl-smoketest. Failing URL: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

docs-bot: link-checker: test docs/samples/curl-smoketest failed (403) :warning:

omar: quick look 33 probably missing Content-Type and using internal hostname. Example currently:```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'
```

liam: suggested fix: add `-H 'Content-Type: application/json'` and switch host to `https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate`. Also add a short parenthetical pointing to the tokens page so folks know where to get REDWOOD_KEY.

omar: I can open a tiny PR (will also update expected status in the smoketest fixture).

tess: thanks. can you also update the inline response example: it shows \"200 OK\" but actual response body changed shape in last model rollout (now has `id` + `output.text`). small change but would avoid future CI flakes.

omar: noted. PR will: header + host + response body sample + test fixture bump + add `docs-owner: eng-runtime` frontmatter.

liam: ownership note: runtime samples should preferably be adopted by eng-runtime in CODEOWNERS; if not, add docs-owner frontmatter like you said. quick one-line fixes should be fine as docs-driven PRs.

omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872. pinging @liam @tess for review. :eyes:

tess: will review after standup. please add a one-liner in PR description listing what CI checks you expect to change (curl-smoketest).

deploy-bot: docs-site deploy will run after merge. watch `docs-ci/curl-smoketest` and `docs-site/build`.

omar: updated PR with alt-text tweak and rebased; CI running.

liam: LGTM pending green smoketest. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

tess: cheers, leaving for CODEOWNERS follow-up later this week.
